title: भाषाविज्ञानको उद्भव र विकासमा पूर्वीय संस्कृत परम्पराको योगदान
nepali: यो लेख भाषाविज्ञानको उद्भव र विकासमा संस्कृत भाषा र व्याकरणको अध्ययन परम्पराले पु¥याएको योगदानमा आधारित रहेको छ । संस्कृत भाषाका विद्वान्आचार्यहरूले भाषा र व्याकरणको खोजअन्वेषणका क्रममा आधुनिक भाषाविज्ञानलाई पृष्ठपोषण प्राप्त हुने केकस्तो योगदान पु¥याएका छन्भन्ने मूल समस्याको समाधानमा केन्द्रित भएर उक्त समस्याको विश्लेषण गर्ने उद्देश्य रहेको छ । यही उद्देश्यको सीमामा रही मुख्यतः पुस्तकालय र आंशिक रूपमा क्षेत्रीय अध्ययनविधिको प्रयोग गरेर संस्कृत परम्परामा भएका भाषावैज्ञानिक गुणका अध्ययन कार्य र त्यसले आधुनिक भाषाविज्ञानको विकासमा पु¥याएको योगदानलाई यसमा सङ्क्षिप्त रूपमा देखाइएको छ । आधुनिक भाषाविज्ञानको वैज्ञानिक विकास १९औँ शताब्दीदेखि पश्चिमबाट थालनी भएको देखिए पनि पूर्वीय संस्कृत परम्पराका वैदिकयुग, पाणिनियुग र पाणिनिउत्तर युगसम्मको अतिदीर्घ समयावधिमा विद्वान्आचार्यहरूले भाषा र व्याकरणको निकै सम्पन्न परम्परा स्थापित गरेका छन्। यसले आधुनिक भाषाविज्ञानको उद्भव र विकासमा आवश्यक पृष्ठभूमि प्रदान गरेको छ । तसर्थ आधुनिक भाषाविज्ञानको श्रीवृद्धिमा पूर्वीय संस्कृत भाषा र व्याकरण परम्पराको योगदान अविस्मरणीय रहेको छ भन्ने कुरालाई यसमा देखाइएको छ ।
american_english: This article is based on the contribution made by the study tradition of Sanskrit language and grammar to the origin and development of linguistics. Its purpose is to analyze that problem by focusing on solving the core problem of what kind of contribution the scholars and teachers of Sanskrit made to modern linguistics in the course of their inquiry into language and grammar, through which modern linguistics gained feedback. Within the scope of this purpose, mainly through the library method and partly through field study methods, the linguistic merits found in the Sanskrit tradition and the contribution they made to the development of modern linguistics are shown here in brief. Although the scientific development of modern linguistics appears to have begun in the West from the nineteenth century, over an extremely long period spanning the Vedic, Paninian and post-Paninian eras of the Eastern Sanskrit tradition, scholars and teachers established a highly developed tradition of language and grammar. This provided the necessary background for the origin and development of modern linguistics. Therefore, this shows that the contribution of the Eastern Sanskrit language and grammar tradition to the advancement of modern linguistics is unforgettable.

informal_english: So this article is about the contribution the Sanskrit language and grammar study tradition made to the birth and growth of linguistics. Its aim is to get at the core question of what sort of contribution Sanskrit scholars and teachers made to modern linguistics while they were digging into language and grammar, the sort that gave modern linguistics a leg up. Working within that aim, mainly through library research and partly through field study, it briefly shows the linguistic strengths of the Sanskrit tradition and what they did for modern linguistics. Even though modern linguistics seems to have got going scientifically in the West from the nineteenth century, over a hugely long stretch covering the Vedic, Paninian and post-Paninian ages of the Eastern Sanskrit tradition, scholars and teachers built up a really rich tradition of language and grammar. That laid the groundwork modern linguistics needed to get started and grow. So the article makes the point that the Eastern Sanskrit language and grammar tradition's contribution to the flourishing of modern linguistics is one we shouldn't forget.
